newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Talbots coverage started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Talbots coverage started.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities said Tuesday it began coverage of Talbots Inc with an intermediate- and long-term rating of outperform.
-- "We believe Talbots is emerging as a premier private label brand merchant of high quality, classic women's apparel," EVEREN wrote in a report.
-- It set earnings estimates for Talbots of $1.87 a share for 1996, $2.30 a share for 1997 and $2.65 for 1998.
-- It said a "reasonable" six-month target price for the stock is $36 a share. Talbots shares were up 3/4 at 29.
